name: entyrix-mcp
description: KYB data from 23 European business registries — search, financials, compliance, network graphs.
long_description: Query 23 European business registries through one MCP server. Ten tools cover typo-tolerant company search, registry-ID lookup, full company profiles (financials, tech stack, NIS2, sanctions, credit grade), 57-key advanced filtering, multi-year financial statements, public-sector supplier contracts, shared-officer relation graphs and pre-computed rankings. Bring your own Entyrix API key from https://entyrix.com.

api_key.title: Entyrix API key
api_key.description: Bearer token from entyrix.com (dashboard → API keys)

base_url.title: Base URL
base_url.description: Override for staging or self-hosted Entyrix

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Typo-tolerant search by company name, partial name or address across 23 markets.

tools.name: lookup_company
tools.description: Resolve a registry ID (IČO / company number) to a company, country-aware.

tools.name: get_company_details
tools.description: Full profile: registry data, financials, tech stack, security posture, NIS2, sanctions, credit grade.

tools.name: get_company_network
tools.description: Shared-officer and ownership network graph around a company.

tools.name: get_company_relations
tools.description: Direct relations: officers, parents, subsidiaries, beneficial owners.

tools.name: advanced_search
tools.description: Structured filtering over the whole catalogue — 57 filter keys (country, NACE, size, financials, risk flags).

tools.name: check_compliance
tools.description: AML / sanctions / debarment screening plus NIS2 scope for a given company.

tools.name: get_financials
tools.description: Multi-year financial statements: revenue, profit, assets, equity, employees.

tools.name: find_suppliers
tools.description: Public-sector contracts a company has won, as supplier or as contracting authority.

tools.name: list_rankings
tools.description: Pre-computed leaderboards by turnover, employees, contracts or credit grade.
